exposure: transfusion at delivery but no other indication of severe maternal morbidity
long length of stay in the hospital after delivery
less than a high school education
cohort: 29,654 women with a stillbirth in California from 1997 to 2011
finding: Women with comorbidities, birth-related complications, non-Hispanic Black race and ethnicity, or less education had increased odds of postpartum readmission after having a stillbirth.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of postpartum readmission after stillbirth.
